effect.name: GM Text Cascade
effect.desc: A time driven build-on and tear-down. Every character is given an ORDER KEY along the line, and the build progress sweeps those keys one after another - so the text assembles itself. Order can run Forward, Backward, start at the Center and work Out, start at the Edges and work In, go Random, or assemble Word by Word. Stagger sets how far apart the characters are; at zero the whole line lands together, at maximum it becomes a long per-character cascade. Three reveal styles: Typewriter simply withholds the character, Placeholder Wipe parks a chosen glyph in its slot so the layout never reflows, and Scramble boils unrevealed characters through a glyph pool. Reverse Out collapses the finished line again from the end, on its own clock, so one effect covers both the in and the out.
